verdict.rationale: Slate's docs say it can perform integration tests manually, which supports verifying fixes. They also say it can deeply research 'your problem' in parallel, which loosely supports root-cause investigation. No documented debugging workflow covers reproducing issues or narrowing root causes, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: documented issue-reproduction workflow, explicit root-cause narrowing or debugging capability, fix-verification loop documentation, independent or hands-on evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reproduce issues, narrow down root causes, and verify fixes

citations.quote: Slate is one of the few agents capable of performing integration tests manually.
Have slate in parallel deeply research your problem
